intro: The road to the Platinum in seven stages. Stages 1–3 are the story; stages 4–6 are the world; stage 7 is cleanup. The order matters: the one possibly missable trophy lives in Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay, so the saves you make in stage 1 protect everything after it.

stages.note: Sources: PowerPyx via Planet GTA 6 (cheats disable trophies); Output Lag (no mission replay, manual saves).
stages.text: Leave cheats off for the whole run — PowerPyx reports that turning on a cheat disables trophies, and GameSpot and PC Gamer add that you cannot save any more once you have used one. Make a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission: the game has no mission replay, so those saves are your only way back. Turn the spoiler setting on if you want the story trophies hidden until you earn them.
stages.title: Stage 0 — Before you start

stages.note: Source: official trophy list (PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles). Story takes around 60 hours per VGC and Push Square, via Planet GTA 6.
stages.text: Play Chapters 1–4 and the final mission in order. Every chapter and named-mission trophy unlocks here and none of them can be missed — except one thing inside Chapter 1: Lucia's balcony meditation counts toward Positive Mental Attitude, and Output Lag reports it disappears after Chapter 1. Do it before the chapter ends.
stages.title: Stage 1 — The story: Chapters 1–4 and the finale

stages.note: Source: official trophy list (PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles).
stages.text: Leonida's strangers hand out short mission chains. There are more than 8 strands, so pick any 8 — the five named character finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward the 8, and Bret's unique-animal hunt sits in the same sweep. Finish strands as you find them while exploring.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Strangers: 8 strands and the character finals

stages.note: Source: official trophy list (PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles).
stages.text: Sample all 9 activity types first (Master of None), then clear them in volume: 250 stunts, 20 different races, a drone-race win at all 14 locations, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 50 challenges, one arcade game, a fishing win against Cal, and a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Activities are the longest grind after collectibles — spread them across the whole run.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Activities: try everything, then clear it

stages.note: Source: official trophy list (PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles). Possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude (GTABase & PowerPyx, via EGamers).
stages.text: Meditate at all 18 spots (do them as you find them — this is the one possibly missable trophy), WAiNK It at 100 locations, finish 3 card sets, discover 100 vehicles, explore all 52 areas, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Do these while you travel for other stages: the same roads serve every count at once.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Collectibles and the map

stages.note: Source: official trophy list (PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles).
stages.text: Five bank vaults, one armored truck, one jewelry store robbed unseen, one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs — and the money to go with it: $250,000 of Marked Bills laundered and $100,000 spent in shops. Work the combat trophies in here too: 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus, a 4-star wanted level lost with your partner, 3 shops robbed back-to-back, the VCIA departure and the Rhinos. Plan every getaway before you go in.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Crime and money

stages.note: Sources: official trophy list; Output Lag (five trophies with no confirmed trigger at launch); EGamers (500 Criminal Profile actions).
stages.text: What is left is the strange and the slow. The cryptic hidden trophies (a cocktail on Ocean Beach, a showroom smash-out, a partnership moment, a second-try success, something strange, a melee drive-by) have no confirmed trigger published at launch — their descriptions are the guide, so try what the words say. Keep making choices until the 500-action count for Actions Speak Louder fills. When everything else is done, A Long Road (100% completion, the 35-task checklist) and the Platinum pop together.
stages.title: Stage 6 — Odd ones, choices, and the Platinum
